annotations.title: Validate and format a Chilean RUT

description: Check a Chilean RUT's modulo 11 check digit and return it normalized (12.345.678-5). Use it to catch typos before saving a record. Does not confirm the person or company exists with the SII. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: POST /cl/rut via x402.

rut.description: RUT with or without dots and dash, e.g. 12345678-5 or 12.345.678-5.
